items.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
items.summary: The article investigates how to evaluate language‑model data attribution methods by systematically varying dataset properties to isolate failure causes.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding attribution failures helps build more reliable, accountable AI systems.

items.title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
items.summary: The paper proposes a method to scale differential privacy noise based on typical data sensitivity by privately filtering out influential records.
items.whyItMatters: It can reduce noise and improve accuracy for most users while preserving privacy.

items.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
items.summary: The article shows pretrained language models can be fine-tuned by perturbing a single decoder block, challenging the Neural Thickets hypothesis.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers should note simpler, efficient fine-tuning methods exist, reducing computational cost and complexity.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.summary: The paper proposes role‑coupled tokenization, separating low‑frequency global tokens from high‑frequency local tokens to reduce attention cost in pixel‑space Transformers.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it improves efficiency of image generation models.

items.title: Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
items.summary: The paper proposes adaptive scenario generation for KL-DRO to improve robustness in two-stage stochastic programs by expanding ambiguity sets beyond reweightings.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it enhances model reliability under limited data, a common issue in AI deployments.

items.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
items.summary: The paper explores methods for re-identifying luggage across separate camera views in complex environments like airports and border crossings.
items.whyItMatters: It improves security and lost‑baggage recovery, crucial for tech‑savvy professionals in surveillance and logistics.

items.title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
items.summary: WxCrop uses agentic AI to predict crop damage from extreme weather by interpreting weather indices causally.
items.whyItMatters: It helps farmers and insurers forecast losses, improving resilience and risk management.

items.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
items.summary: World2vec learns mechanistic world models from observations and actions, capturing true latent dynamics without reward signals for better interpretability.
items.whyItMatters: It enables scientifically meaningful models that can be analyzed and used for discovery, not just control.

items.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
items.summary: The paper investigates whether visual foundation models can maintain and update spatial state representations for navigation and action beyond the current view.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding this could improve AI navigation, robotics, and augmented reality by enabling persistent spatial awareness.

items.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
items.summary: The article explains how shallow safety alignment in LLMs causes multi-turn conversations to bypass safety checks, and proposes ShallowDefend to address this.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it improves model reliability and reduces harmful outputs in interactive AI systems.

items.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
items.summary: The article discusses the need for evidence-based significance testing of temporal clinical hypotheses, rather than relying on language model assertions without statistical backing.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers should ensure AI-generated claims are statistically validated to avoid misleading conclusions.

items.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
items.summary: The paper shows discrete diffusion models can be represented by an ODE, enabling faster sampling and consistency distillation.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers can leverage this for more efficient generative modeling and improved inference speed.

items.title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
items.summary: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. items.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
items.summary: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing…

items.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
items.summary: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end…

items.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
items.summary: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess…

items.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
items.summary: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in? items.title: Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
items.summary: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources. While multistatic ISAC can increase sensing coverage with spatially distributed receivers, dense and dynamic clutter can significantly degrade bistatic range and Doppler estimation, leading to errors in…

items.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
items.summary: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital…

items.title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
items.summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget.
